packageRules.description: Playwright's npm package and Docker image move in lockstep; the image tag can lag the npm release, so automerge stays off to stop a solo npm-only bump from landing unmatched.

The Containerfile's CATALOG_VERSION ARG and the .gitlab-ci.yml component pins track the same dunn.dev/pipeline release and must bump together in one MR; automerge stays off because a stale ARG breaks the next tag build once the old image tag is registry-GC'd.

The native dockerfile manager would also track this same ARG as its own unguarded dependency, bypassing the pipeline catalog rule's automerge:false gate; disabled so the annotated-ARG customManager is the only thing that ever proposes an update to that line.

customManagers.description: Tracks the dunn.dev/pipeline component version pins in .gitlab-ci.yml's `component:` includes via regex, since Renovate's native gitlabci component support does not pick them up; matches the same gitlab-tags dependency as the Containerfile's CATALOG_VERSION ARG so both group under the "pipeline catalog" rule.
